unit.children.description: the units below: reachable, KPI status counts, escalated items, open requests

unit.exposed.description: what this unit exposes to the caller; with child (a name or *) what the units below expose to this one

child.description: a child unit: its own figures instead of this unit's

unit.goals.description: goals set for this unit from above, measured on its KPIs, and the ones it set for its children

child.description: a child unit: its own figures instead of this unit's

unit.info.description: this unit: name, title, layer, parent, owner

unit.items.description: risks, blockers, decisions, incidents and highlights, with the children's escalated ones

child.description: a child unit: its own figures instead of this unit's

unit.kpis.description: delivery KPIs with their targets and status (ok, warn, err)

child.description: a child unit: its own figures instead of this unit's

unit.people.description: people figures at unit level (headcount, open roles, load): never per person

child.description: a child unit: its own figures instead of this unit's

unit.reports.description: reports this unit published upward; with child (a name or *) the units below's

child.description: a child unit: its own figures instead of this unit's

unit.requests.description: requests this unit got from above and the ones it sent below, with their answers

unit.show.description: read an exposed source by name, with its declared inputs

child.description: a child unit whose exposure this is

unit.answer.description: accept, answer, decline or close a request this unit got

unit.goal.description: give a child unit (to) a goal, record one from above here, or change a goal's status (id)

from.description: the giving unit (a parent fills it)

id.description: an existing goal: change its status or note

kpi.description: the unit's KPI that measures it

status.description: open, accepted, met, missed or dropped

to.description: the child unit to give it to; empty records it here

unit.invoke.description: run an exposed action by name, with its declared inputs only

child.description: a child unit whose exposure this is

unit.item.description: record or update a risk, blocker, decision, incident or highlight

unit.report.description: publish a report (status, release, retro) for the units above

unit.request.description: ask a child unit (to) for something, or record a request from above here

from.description: the asking unit (a parent fills it)

to.description: the child unit to ask; empty records it here
